summary: Iteration 59: Toxic Spikes Alert System Testing Complete. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Email alerts confirmed sent via Resend to admin@risedual.ai and managingdirector@redslateholdings.com. In-app notifications created for 14 Pro users.
